#!/bin/bash    
set -euo pipefail # set up error handling: fail on any command with exit code !=0 , fail with undefined variables.
export SHELLOPTS # export the settings for all subshells. Be careful with the "u" (undefined variables) flag, some tools (such as maven) fail. 

cd /app
source copado_init
function_parameter region '{$Pipeline.Property.Rapid7_Region}'
function_parameter apiKey '{$Pipeline.Property.xAPIKey}'
function_parameter appSecFileId '{$Pipeline.Property.InsightAppSecFileId}'
function_parameter swagerFileVersionId '{$Context.Apex.cmcMule.GetSwagerFileVersionId}'
function_parameter rapid7InsightAppSecAppId '{$Pipeline.Property.InsightAppSecAppId}'
function_parameter insightAppSec_Scan_Config_Id '{$Pipeline.Property.InsightAppSec_Scan_Config_Id}'
#region='us3'
#apiKey='c70d0fc1-7b41-41c2-9857-0daeb716af6a'
#appSecFileId='d8579880-29c3-4a77-888c-6824c6bf604b'
#swagerFileVersionId='0681w000002WKHiAAO'
#rapid7InsightAppSecAppId='6b76f574-c63a-419f-9b95-8e1076402f24'
#rapid7InsightAppSecScanConfigId='b9add2c3-030b-4bd8-a50f-b867f647989b'

validationUrl="https://${region}.api.insight.rapid7.com/validate"

echo "$SHELLOPTS"

if [ -z "$swagerFileVersionId" ]
then
    copado -p "Skipping InsightAppSec Scan"
    copado_finish 0 "Swagger file is not attached" "" " Skipped Scan"
fi

copado -p "Authenticating Rapid7"
    authResponse=$(curl --location "${validationUrl}" \
--header "X-Api-Key: ${apiKey}") || {
        echo $authResponse
        copado_finish 1 "Authentication failed" "" "$authResponse"
    }
    echo $authResponse
    authMessage=$(echo $authResponse | jq -r '.message')
    if [[ "$authMessage" == "Unauthorized" ]]; then
        copado_finish 1 "Unable to authenticate Rapid7" "" "$authResponse"
    fi
    echo $authMessage
    
copado -p "Uploading Swagger File to InsightAppSec"
copado --downloadfiles "$swagerFileVersionId"
value=$(<InsightAppSecSwagger)
contentUploadUrl="https://${region}.api.insight.rapid7.com:443/ias/v1/apps/${rapid7InsightAppSecAppId}/files/${appSecFileId}"
contentUploadResponse=$(curl -w "%{response_code}" --location "${contentUploadUrl}" \
--header "X-Api-Key: ${apiKey}" \
--header 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' \
--data-raw "$value") || {
        echo $contentUploadResponse
        copado_finish 1 "File Content upload failed" "" "$contentUploadResponse"
    }
echo $contentUploadResponse

if [[ "$contentUploadResponse" != "201" ]]; then
        copado_finish 1 "Failed to upload swagger file content" "" "$contentUploadResponse"
fi
#Submit scan
copado -p "Submitting Scan request"
value="{\"scan_config\": {\"id\": \"${insightAppSec_Scan_Config_Id}\"}, \"scan_type\": \"REGULAR\"}"
echo $value
scanURL="https://${region}.api.insight.rapid7.com/ias/v1/scans"
scanResponse=$(curl -w "%{response_code}" --location "${scanURL}" \
--header "X-Api-Key: ${apiKey}" \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw "$value") || {
        echo $scanResponse
        copado_finish 1 "Rapid7 Scan request submitted successfully " "" "$scanResponse"
    }
echo $scanResponse

if [[ "$scanResponse" != "201" ]]; then
        copado_finish 1 "Failed submit Rapid7 scan request" "" "$scanResponse"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eo pipefail

export baseUrl="https://$(echo $Endpoint | sed -e 's/[^/]*\/\/\([^@]*@\)\?\([^:/]*\).*/\2/')"
copado -p "setting up sfdx context"
sfdx force:project:create -n monitor
cd monitor
sfdx force:config:set instanceUrl=${baseUrl} || echo "error setting instanceUrl"

## Query SFDC for impersonations
query="select Name from User where Username='$IntegrationUsername'"
copado -p "executing User query"
sfdx force:data:soql:query -u $SessionID -q "$query" --json |jq --raw-output '.result' > userDetails.json  || echo "error executing User query"

## Query SFDC for impersonations
query="SELECT ID, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedBy.Username, Display from SetupAuditTrail WHERE createddate >= LAST_N_DAYS:3 AND Action = 'suOrgAdminLogin'"
copado -p "executing Impersonation query"
sfdx force:data:soql:query -u $SessionID -q "$query" --json |jq --raw-output '.result' > impersonations.json  || echo "error executing Impersonation query"


## Query SFDC for metadata changes NOT made by the integration user OR they were made by impersonation
query="SELECT ID, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedBy.Username, Action, Section, Display, DelegateUser FROM SetupAuditTrail WHERE createddate >= LAST_N_DAYS:3 AND CreatedByID !=null AND CreatedBy.Name !='Automated+Process'  AND ((CreatedBy.Username != '$IntegrationUsername') OR DelegateUser != null)"
copado -p "executing Metadata query"
sfdx force:data:soql:query -u $SessionID -q "$query" --json |jq --raw-output '.result' > metadatachanges.json  || echo "error executing Metadata query"

## Save impersonation file back to Copado Salesforce Org so it can be processed
copado -p "Uploading result files"
copado -u impersonations.json
copado -u metadatachanges.json
copado -u userDetails.json

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail # set up error handling: fail on any command with exit code !=0 , fail with undefined variables.
export SHELLOPTS # export the settings for all subshells. Be careful with the "u" (undefined variables) flag, some tools (such as maven) fail.

cd /app
source copado_init
function_parameter promotion_id '{$Context.JobExecution__r.Promotion__c}' --optional
# Define an empty access token variable
access_token=""

function verify_client_id_secret() {

    copado -p "Authenticating Mulesoft Anypoint Platform"

    # Define the validation URLs in an associative array for easy access
    declare -A validation_urls=(
        ["US"]="https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token"
        ["EU"]="https://eu1.anypoint.mulesoft.com/accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token"
        ["GOV"]="https://gov.anypoint.mulesoft.com/accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token"
    )

    # Check if the anypoint_region value is a valid key in the validation_urls array
    if [[ -v validation_urls["$anypoint_region"] ]]; then 
        authenticate_credentials "${validation_urls[$anypoint_region]}" "$client_id" "$client_secret"
    else 
        copado -p 'Invalid region entered' --error-message 'Invalid region selected' 
        exit 1
    fi
}


# This function is to authenticate the user credentials
function authenticate_credentials {
    local auth_http_code
    local json_response

    auth_http_code=$(curl --silent --output /dev/stderr --write-out "%{http_code}" --location --request POST "$1" \
                      --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
                      --data-urlencode "client_id=$2" \
                      --data-urlencode "client_secret=$3" \
                      --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials')

    if [[ $auth_http_code -ne 200 ]]; then
        copado -p 'Invalid credential error' --error-message 'Invalid Client Id or Client Secret'
        exit 1
    fi

    json_response=$(curl --silent --location --request POST "$1" \
                 --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
                 --data-urlencode "client_id=$2" \
                 --data-urlencode "client_secret=$3" \
                 --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials')

    access_token=$(echo "$json_response" | jq -r '.access_token')
}

function download_swagger_file(){
      response=$(curl --location --request GET "https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/exchange/api/v1/assets/${group_id}/${asset_id}/"\
      --header "Authorization: Bearer $access_token")

      external_link=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.files[] | select(.classifier == "oas").externalLink')
      
      cd /app

      # URL of the zip file to download
      zip_url=$external_link

      # Destination directory for the extracted files
      destination_dir="/app"

      # Download the zip file
      copado -p "Downloading the zip file..." 
      curl -sS -o temp.zip "$zip_url"

      # Extract the contents of the zip file
      copado -p "Extracting the zip file..."  
      unzip -q temp.zip -d "$destination_dir"
	  
      # Uploading the swagger file 
      copado -p "Uploading the swagger file ..."  
      copado -u /app/api.json -n "swagger.json" -i "$promotion_id"

	  # Removing the zip folder
      rm temp.zip
}

profiler verify_client_id_secret
profiler download_swagger_file
